notes:
Lead: RadialNote AI — building a lightweight RAG layer for SMB legal teams. Inbound started from doc-search landing page. Main ask: hosted embeddings + reranking pipeline, seamless vector DB connectivity (they currently use Pinecone).

Customer profile: 60 employees, small engineering team (2 full-time backend), product-first PM. Mostly public-cloud (GCP). Cost sensitive; want to keep monthly inference bill < $2k initially.

Key quotes: "We need relevant snippets, not hallucination — reranking is critical."; "Can we keep embeddings local to our project and still use Redwood hosted API for generation?"

Technical notes (shorthand):
- Corpus: ~120k docs (legal templates + precedents), avg doc length 1.2k tokens, expect incremental daily updates (~1k docs/day).
- QPS target: 10-15 qps at peak for search service, sub-300ms retrieval latency desirable, generation can be async for longer answers.
requirements_summary: Embeddings + reranking pipeline with vector DB integration (Pinecone), low-cost hosted embeddings option, support for batched embedding jobs and incremental reindex, configurable reranker (prefer Redwood reranker or light-weight cross-encoder), 99% request success with graceful fallback to smaller model when cost/latency spikes.
integration_questions: - How does Redwood host embeddings vs customer-side embeddings? - Can Redwood connect directly to Pinecone or we should proxy embeddings through our infra? - Support for embedding batching, rate limits, and backfill jobs? - Example latency numbers for 512-token embeddings + reranking (hosted API) under 10 qps?
sales_notes: AE notes: good fit for self-serve hosted API adoption; likely to stay self-serve unless procurement triggers. Ask: send granular pricing for embeddings and token cost scenarios. Offer: 3-month credits for initial PoC if needed.
technical_risks: Token cost for long context RAG; index staleness for daily updates; legal team needs evidence of SOC2 and basic data handling SLA.
preferred_models: Open-embedding-512 or Redwood-curated embeddings; prefer to test cheaper quantized generators for reranking stage.
customer_concerns: Worried about hidden costs (re-embedding on every doc change), vector DB egress charges, and how fallback routing works if hosted capacity is saturated.
customer_decision_criteria: 1) cost predictability for embeddings + generation; 2) straightforward Pinecone integration; 3) SOC2 + SSO support; 4) clear latency numbers for 10 qps profile.
